snippet.title: Deep Dish Dungeon | Date Reveal Trailer | Coming October 13th
snippet.description:
Deep Dish Dungeon will launch on October 13 on Steam, XBOX Series S/X and GamePass Day One. Plus, it will be XBOX handheld verified and support Xbox Play Anywhere.

Explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve their campsite. A survival exploration game with metroidvania and crafting elements.
